text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwe's higher education ministry borrowed Z$10 million from a local bank to enable the University of Zimbabwe to pay the remaining 25 percent in outstanding government sponsorship to first year students.
- Police in Harare may soon open dockets against two businessmen who have been linked to an alleged sex ring involving street children.

- Standard Chartered Bank Zimbabwe workers who are on strike over bonus payment grievances filed an application in the High Court seeking reversal of a disposal order issued by the Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Social Welfare last week.
